frontend_framework: Next.js 16 (App Router / TypeScript / Turbopack) + Streamlit Companion
rationale: Next.js provides a decoupled production architecture with responsive React state, client-side HTTP API consumption with X-API-Key auth, interactive SVG heatmaps, and clean Docker multi-stage build support for Prompt 18. Streamlit (src/ui/app.py) is maintained as a zero-Node Python companion dashboard.

gate_2_privacy_notice_enforcement.description: Pre-upload privacy and data retention disclosure is displayed and acknowledgment is strictly required before the upload button is enabled.

gate_3_disclaimer_presence.description: 'Research tool, not legal advice' disclaimer is surfaced across all 5 tab views (Upload, Results, XAI, Feedback, Transparency).

gate_4_claim_discipline.description: Scanned all UI copy and code for prohibited claims (e.g., 'production-ready', 'enterprise-grade'). Zero violations found.

starting_point_for_prompt_18: Frontend and backend both run and build locally. Ready for Docker containerization (backend Dockerfile with spaCy/torch, frontend Dockerfile for Next.js, docker-compose.yml with Postgres and MinIO, feedback SQLite->Postgres migration script, and deterministic local smoke test).
